theorem card_concat (n n' : Nat) (K K' : List Nat → Bool) :
    card (n + n') (concat n K K') = card n K * card n' K'

theorem adj_concat (n n' : Nat) (K K' : List Nat → Bool) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hn' : 1 ≤ n') :
    adj (n + n') (concat n K K') = adj n K * card n' K' + card n K * adj n' K'
def dbl (n : Nat) (K : List Nat → Bool) : Nat → (List Nat → Bool)

theorem dbl_props {n : Nat} {K : List Nat → Bool} (hK : IsDom n K) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ∀ k,
    IsDom (2 ^ k * n) (dbl n K k) ∧ card (2 ^ k * n) (dbl n K k) = card n K ^ (2 ^ k) ∧
      adj (2 ^ k * n) (dbl n K k) * card n K = 2 ^ k * adj n K * card n K ^ (2 ^ k)

theorem deletionSum_le_general {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin (n + 1))}

theorem deletionSum_le_peakPit {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin (n + 1))}

theorem IsFull.median_mem {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin n)} (hD : IsFull D)
    (u v w : Order (Fin n)) (hu : u ∈ D) (hv : v ∈ D) (hw : w ∈ D) :
    medianOrder hD.isCondorcet u v w hu hv hw ∈ D

theorem IsFull.component_from_fixed {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin n)}
    (hD : IsFull D) (r s : Order (Fin n)) (hr : r ∈ D) (hs : s ∈ D)
    (hfixed : ∀ i : Pair n,
      (∀ q ∈ D, Connected D r q → encode q i = encode r i) → encode s i = encode r i) :
    Connected D r s

theorem component_membership {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin n)} (hD : IsFull D)
    (r s : Order (Fin n)) (hr : r ∈ D) :
    s ∈ component D r ↔ s ∈ D ∧ HoldsPairs (componentPairs D r) s
theorem encode_injective {n : Nat} : Function.Injective (@encode n)

theorem IsFull.component_inF {n : Nat} {D : Domain (Fin n)}

theorem IsFull.components_inF {n : Nat} {D K : Domain (Fin n)}
    (hD : IsFull D) (hK : K ∈ components D) : InF K

theorem sum_components_card {n : Nat} (D : Domain (Fin n)) :
    ∑ K ∈ components D, K.card = D.card
